# MemOS Local attribution

The optional OpenClaw memory lane is installed from the MemOS Local OpenClaw
plugin published by [MemTensor/MemOS](https://github.com/MemTensor/MemOS).
The upstream component is MIT licensed. This repository does not modify the
discovered upstream checkout; `repository-memory memos install` stages a
revision-pinned copy under the user's data directory, applies only local build
compatibility fixes, and links that staged copy into OpenClaw.

The Git evidence lane, citation contract, and repository-memory runtime remain
independent of the optional MemOS component.
